mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC over last 5 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over last 5 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or positive returns fail in >60% of rising HOUST/RSAFS instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise ≥0.5% in 3 months), or Rank IC over last 5 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor markets that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of months when PAYEMS growth ≥100k, or Rank IC over last 5 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >55% of months when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over last 5 years < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) indicate manufacturing contraction amid monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (INDPRO * FEDFUNDS) Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or negative returns fail in >60% of INDPRO<95.0 and FEDFUNDS>0.2% instances.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansions, strong GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals accelerating economic activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (GDPC1 * HOUST) Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or positive returns fail in >60% of early-cycle expansion instances.
